home_models_intro: This site covers the Merlin M2 and the generations before it.
costs_intro: What does a Fullwood Merlin cost per year? First a general budget, then a dairy farm that kept track of every invoice.
costs_why_1: When buying a milking robot, attention goes to the price of the robot itself. What it costs every year afterwards in cleaning agents, parts, service, licences, water and electricity is much harder to find.
costs_why_2: The manual gives consumption figures, but practice differs. At 180 milkings a day, measured use of teat dip and disinfectant comes to 20 and 16 jerrycans a year, where the user manual arrives at 65.
costs_why_3: That is why this is a budget based on actual use, with the calculation shown for every item. You can adjust it for your own farm: more or fewer milkings, different prices.
costs_why_4: Prices also change quickly. Acid cleaner now costs about {acid} more than in 2019, and electricity more than twice the price noted earlier. An old cost picture is soon out of date.
costs_why_note_body: The amounts come from one user and show the order of magnitude. Your farm, region and supplier may differ.
costs_basis_body: All amounts assume {milkings} milkings, {hot} hot cleanings and {rinses} rinses of the Merlin M2 per day. That is {perYear} milkings per year.

farm_title: 13 years of Merlin and the switch to the M2
farm_intro: A dairy farm with {milkings} milkings a day. A Merlin since 2009, a Merlin M2 since August 2022. Here are all recorded costs: per year, per item and per litre of milk.
farm_stat_cents_label: per litre of milk, purchase and maintenance combined
farm_stat_m2_label: average per year with the M2 (years 1 to 4)
farm_why_1: Invoices quickly disappear into the accounts and are rarely added up over the years. This farm kept every invoice around the milking robot and added them up per year, so you can see what a robot costs over its whole life.
farm_why_2: The aim is not to prove that a robot is cheap or expensive, but to show what to expect: which items are fixed, which fluctuate, and what one large repair does to a year.
farm_why_3: This farmer’s rule of thumb: a milking robot costs 3 to 5 cents per litre of milk.
farm_method_title: What is and is not counted
farm_method_1: All amounts come from invoices from the dealer and from suppliers of cleaning agents.
farm_method_2: One-off purchases, such as the installation, a new cooling machine or a pasture box, are listed separately and are not part of the yearly costs.
farm_method_3: Water and electricity are not included.
farm_method_4: The calendar years 2009 to 2023 include VAT; the usage years of the Merlin M2 exclude VAT.
farm_years_lede: What the robot cost per calendar year in service, parts and licences. One-off items are listed below the chart.
farm_years_aria: Costs per calendar year from 2009 to 2023
farm_years_avg: On average {avg} per year over the 13 years with the first Merlin (2009 to 2022). There is no data for 2012 and 2013; {estimate} per year was estimated for those.
farm_years_avg_note: This average follows the total of {total}, which the owner adjusted by {adjustment}.
farm_m2_lede: Per usage year from the installation in August 2022, split into categories. Open a year to see every line.
farm_m2_aria: Costs per usage year of the Merlin M2, by category
farm_ongoing_note: Year 4 is still running and is not complete; the total is still growing.
farm_overview_title: The four years side by side
farm_compare_title: Budget and practice side by side
farm_compare_lede: The general budget assumes 180 milkings a day; this farm milks 120 times a day. Below, the average of years 1 to 4 next to the budget, without water and electricity.
farm_compare_conclusion: The difference is mostly in service, repairs and the milk tank and cooling. These items are missing from the budget or were estimated lower. Chemicals and consumables come out lower in practice, in line with 120 instead of 180 milkings a day.
farm_life_title: Purchase and total cost per litre
farm_life_lede: Over 13 years with the first Merlin: what the installation cost and what maintenance added.
farm_life_aria: Split between purchase and maintenance over 13 years
farm_life_liters: A total of {liters} litres of milk in 13 years. Purchase {purchase} per litre, maintenance {maintenance} per litre.
farm_purchases_note: The complete 2009 installation includes assembly, preparatory work, pedometers and accessories, and is therefore higher than the robot and tank combined.
farm_life_remarks: Replacing the robot with the Merlin M2 came out cheaper thanks to less labour and changes to the barn. According to the owner, the screw compressor and the milk tank can last for years.
farm_notes_2: Merlin M2 bought in January 2022, installed on 18 August 2022.
farm_notes_3: Chemicals are a continuous stock with peaks in ordering, so the amount per year can shift.
farm_notes_4: The periods of the M2 years are derived from the invoice dates.
